SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY

  THURSDAY – MARCH 26, 2020 – 7:00 P.M.
  TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY
  STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
  VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 509 003 7391

  *COVID-19 NOTICE*

To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19
emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent
with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County
Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will
participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will
be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.

Agenda materials
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public
inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor
Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public
inspection at www.cerritos.us.

How to observe the meeting
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at
www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3. The public can provide comment through
teleconference or email as described in the public comment instructions listed below.

Public Comments
Public comments are limited to the items listed on this Special Meeting agenda only.
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:

Teleconference participation: You may provide verbal public comment by connecting
to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone call (please select only one
method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on
the agenda. Please observe meeting decorum.

Cerritos Zoom Meeting online link: https://us04web.zoom.us/j/5090037391
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: 669-900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 509 003 7391

Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to
city_clerk@cerritos.us by 5:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the
meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in
the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of
the City Council and retained with the public record of the meeting.

Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation
in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer
at 562-916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide
reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY – MARCH 26, 2020 – 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND
N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 509 003 7391

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The pledge of allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

4.  Public Comments

  This section is reserved for comments related to items listed on the Special
  Meeting agenda only.

  Katherine Chu spoke regarding whether any Sheriff’s Department personnel have
  tested positive for COVID-19.

  Leah Nass commented on available hospital beds in the Cerritos area.

  Chuong Vo spoke regarding the type of oversight in place as related to the proposed
  local emergency resolution.

  Scott Andrews inquired whether Cerritos will adopt a moratorium on commercial
  evictions.

  Won Park requested clarification on the proposed local emergency resolution.

  Norma Williamson expressed concerns regarding lack of social distancing at City
  parks.

  Ernie Nishii expressed support for the City Council and ABC Unified School Board to
  work together during the local emergency.

  Kirit Chauhan inquired as to the City’s continuity plans as a result of the impact of
  the local emergency.

5.  New Business

5A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS CONFIRMING THE CITY
  MANAGER/DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY SERVICES PROCLAMATION OF THE EXISTENCE
  OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY CONCERNING THE COVID-19 VIRUS (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  March 26, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 2

5.  New Business (continued)

5A.  (continued)

  A staff report was given by Torrey Contreras, Senior Assistant City Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The public was provided an opportunity to provide comment on all special meeting
  agenda items (Agenda Item 4) in accordance with the provisions of the California
  Brown Act.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Yokoyama, to waive full
  reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2020-05, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS CONFIRMING THE CITY
  MANAGER/DIRECTOR OF EMERGENCY SERVICES PROCLAMATION OF THE
  EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY CONCERNING THE COVID-19 VIRUS
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

5B.  Review and consideration of an information update on the City’s response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The public was provided an opportunity to provide comment on all special meeting
  agenda items (Agenda Item 4) in accordance with the provisions of the California
  Brown Act.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

6.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:13 p.m.
